title: Paulina Zelitsky's sunken city off Cuba and her arrest in Mexico
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Paulina Zelitsky's sunken city off Cuba and her arrest in Mexico, about early 2010s at Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So she goes to Mexico to investigate the connection. She's arrested in Mexico severely intimidated by the authorities and sent back to Canada

plain: A researcher and philosopher named Jason Jorjani, on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells the story of a woman named Paulina Zelitsky, who is linked to the claimed discovery of a sunken city off western Cuba in the early 2010s. Jorjani says she went to Mexico to look into a connection with that find, was arrested there, badly intimidated by the authorities, and sent back to Canada. He tells it as a sign that someone did not want that ancient underwater site looked into.
